verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: badge, logo, can, headline, then the CTA on the right. Its flaws are a tiny, near-illegible SOLSTICE wordmark and a can shrunk to an icon. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column with orphaned words ('golden / hour.'), and a decorative circle sits behind it. B has jumbled order and poor balance: the NEW FLAVOR badge and headline are jammed against the top edge, and the subcopy sits under the badge rather than the headline. The middle-right of the canvas is mostly empty, the logo has shrunk to a speck, and the can is pushed to the far right and clipped at the bottom.
